title: Betweenness relations and Fuzzy betweenness relations in fuzzy metric spaces
summary: In this paper, we mainly discuss the constructions and the characteristics of betweenness relations and fuzzy betweenness relations in KM-fuzzy metric spaces. And the family of betweenness relations induced by a KM-fuzzy metric form a nest of betweenness relations.The main focus of this paper is to introduce two different construction methods for fuzzy betweenness relations induced by a KM-fuzzy metric.One of them is directly obtained by using the implication operator.
